# voice-glow-native (vendored)

A React Native take on [voice-glow](https://libraries.dev) by Jakub Antalik,
from `packages/voice-glow` in <https://github.com/Jakubantalik/Libraries.dev>
(MIT, see `LICENSE`). `palettes.ts` copies its eight palettes and lobe
geometry; `index.tsx` redraws the glow with radial gradients on views,
animated by Reanimated, so it runs in Expo Go and on the web.
